node.title: Preserving newlines with Web::Scraper
node.author: nysus
node.doctext:
I'm using Web::Scraper module to scrape text. Given following HTML:

Blah Blah Blah

Note the newlines in the paragraph. I'm trying to preserve the whitespace (newlines) when scraping with this line: process '//p[contains(@class, "myClass")]', 'paragraph' => 'TEXT',

This works but without newlines. I tried RAW instead of TEXT but still have the problem. I seem to remember there being a third option but I can't remember what it is. Thanks.
